prompt: Implement an O(1) LRUCache(capacity) class in cache.py with get(key) -> value|None and put(key, value) evicting the least recently used key.
hidden_test_content:
from cache import LRUCache
c = LRUCache(2)
c.put('a', 1); c.put('b', 2)
assert c.get('a') == 1
c.put('c', 3)
assert c.get('b') is None
assert c.get('a') == 1 and c.get('c') == 3
c.put('a', 10); c.put('d', 4)
assert c.get('c') is None and c.get('a') == 10
